title_candidates: GitHub Copilot can now introduce an unfamiliar repository
summary: A new Copilot shortcut summarizes a repository's purpose, technologies, and contribution guidance directly on github.com.

primary_source.title: Ask Copilot for a repository overview
primary_source.author: GitHub
key_facts: Copilot can generate a high-level overview for an unfamiliar repository on github.com.
The overview covers purpose, technologies, and contribution guidance.
Related prompts can explain contribution paths or summarize recent changes.
The feature is available on all GitHub Copilot plans.

prerequisites: A GitHub account with any Copilot plan
A public repository you have not contributed to

steps.instruction: Open a public GitHub repository that is new to you.
Use the high-level overview prompt or ask Copilot for one.
Note its claims about purpose, language, setup, and contribution.
Check those claims against the repository files.
Ask one follow-up about any mismatch and trust the files.

references.title: Ask Copilot for a repository overview

risk_flags: Generated repository summaries must be checked against project files.
